must_fix.title: Tabs fallback selection uses registration order, not DOM order, contradicting README 'first enabled tab'
must_fix.evidence: src/Tabs.tsx:77-78 derives `enabled` from a Map in tab registration order. Probe: render Tabs defaultValue="b" with tabs [B,C], rerender with [A,B,C], then remove B -> output `selected after removing b: A:false,C:true`. README says 'If the requested value is missing or disabled, the first enabled tab is selected instead' (A is first in the DOM). onValueChange is also not fired, so a controlled parent's value diverges silently. No test covers it.

report:
I'd merge this after one fix: when the selected tab is removed, Tabs picks the wrong fallback tab.

**Checks:** `pnpm test` passes (3 files, 77 tests), and `pnpm typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`) finishes with no errors. The repo has no lint, format or changelog setup to check against.

**Edge cases I probed** with a temporary test file, now deleted. `git status` is back to exactly how I found it.
- **Tabs:** first enabled tab is selected by default; arrow keys, Home and End work in StrictMode.
- **Dialog:** an `autoFocus` child and focus return work in StrictMode. Pressing Escape inside an open Combobox popup in a Dialog closes only the popup.
- **Combobox:** inside a Dialog, choosing with ArrowDown and Enter works and reopening shows every option again. Values with special characters still get distinct ids.

### Must fix
**Tabs: when the selected tab goes away, the fallback isn't the first enabled tab.** The README says "If the requested value is missing or disabled, the first enabled tab is selected instead." The code doesn't do that. `Tabs` builds its "enabled" list from a `Map` in the order tabs registered (`src/Tabs.tsx:77-78`), not the order they appear on the page. So a tab added later always counts as last, even if it renders first.

Probe: render tabs `[B, C]` with `defaultValue="b"`, re-render as `[A, B, C]`, then remove `B`:
```
selected after removing b: A:false,C:true
```
It selects C even though A comes first on the page and is enabled. `onValueChange` isn't called either, so a controlled parent's `value` silently disagrees with what's shown. The fix is to pick the fallback in page order (for example, from the tablist's tabs), plus a test for this case.

### Nits
- **Test location:** `tsconfig.json` includes `"tests"` and there's an empty `tests/` folder in the working tree, but every test file is in `src/`. Not a convention the repo actually follows yet, since it has no tests so far.
- **Focus trap:** only the Tab key is intercepted. The README doesn't say the unstyled backdrop has to be styled to cover the page. Until it is, a mouse click outside can move focus out of the "modal". Listening for `focusin` would make the trap hold no matter how focus moves.
- **Dialog initial focus waits one animation frame.** Right after opening, focus is still on the opener (the probe showed `active right after open: open`).
- **`description` is checked as truthy** in `Dialog`, so a `description` of `0` or `""` renders nothing and drops `aria-describedby`.
- **Combobox reopen position:** reopening with ArrowDown after a selection starts at the first option, not the selected one. The pattern allows this, but starting at the selected option is friendlier.
